law: Every fixed-capacity slot table listed here is built straight on the heap by semio_framework_async::boxed_fixed_slots, so its Default/new fits a thread that owns only boundedThreadStackBytes. Box::new([const { None }; N]) and Box::new(array::from_fn(..)) materialise the whole N * elementSizeBytes array in the constructing frame at opt-level 0, which is what this record exists to keep out of the tree.
